{{Quote|My grand-pap was a farmer. It's a respectable profession. If I wasn't so darned old I'd come to your farm and show you a thing or two...|George}}

'''George Mullner''' is a [[Villagers|villager]] who lives in [[Pelican Town]].

==Schedule==
The 23rd of every season, George has an appointment at [[Harvey's Clinic]], accompanied by [[Evelyn]]. George never visits the [[Ginger Island#Beach Resort|Beach Resort]] on Ginger Island.

Shown below are George's schedules prioritized highest to lowest. For example, if it is raining, that schedule overrides all others below it.

==Relationships==

George is married to [[Evelyn]] and lives with his grandson, [[Alex]]. Alex's deceased mother [[Clara Mullner|Clara]] was his daughter.

==Heart Events==
===Anytime===
At any [[friendship]] level greater than zero friendship points, you may receive a gift in the mail from George.  The chance of receiving a gift in the mail increases as your friendship with George increases.
{|class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"
! style="text-align: left;" | '''Details'''&nbsp;
|-                            
| 
	{|class="wikitable roundedborder"
	|-
	!Item
	!Description

        |Found some good quality stone.<p>Maybe you can build with it or something.</p><p>-George</p>
	|}
|}

===Three Hearts===
{{Hearts|3}}

After reaching 3 hearts with George, he will send the player a recipe in the mail.

===Six Hearts===
{{heart event
 |hearts = 6
 |trigger = Enter George's house when he is home.
 |details = George struggles to reach something on a bookshelf. The player walks to the shelf and retrieves the item for George. He thanks the player and a few moments of silence ensue. George then tells the player why he is in a wheelchair.
}}

==Quotes==
{|class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"
! style="text-align: left;" | '''Regular'''&nbsp;
|-
|

'''First Meeting'''
{{Squote|Hmmph... It's irritating to have to meet all these new people, huh? Name's George, by the way. Now buzz off... Hmmph.}}

'''Regular'''
{{Squote|I'm not much of a talker. Especially not to strangers, if you don't mind me saying.}}
{{Squote|Hmmph... Looks like another gloomy day.}}
{{Squote|I can't talk right now, [young man/miss]. My favorite program is on.}}
{{Squote|So you're a farmer, huh? At least it's honest work.}}
{{Squote|The weekend is no different than any other time, for me. That's how it is when you're retired.}}
{{Squote|Aren't you cold? They don't make sweaters like they used to}}

''Rainy Day''
{{Squote|It's awful cold, isn't it? What a rotten day.}}

''Winter 1''
{{Squote|Ohh... It's so cold. When you're young the cold doesn't bite as hard.}}

''After Linus 0 Heart Event''
{{Squote|I dunno what you did, but those raccoons haven't been back since last week!}}

''4+ Hearts''
{{Squote|My grand-pap was a farmer. It's a respectable profession. If I wasn't so darned old I'd come to your farm and show you a thing or two...}}

''6+ Hearts''
{{Squote|I'm surprised you want to be friends with an old-timer like me.}}
{{Squote|Hello, [Player]. Wanna watch the TV with me?}}

''8+ Hearts''
{{Squote|I wish my legs worked so I could play catch with Alex. That'll never happen.}}
{{Squote|I've been thinking...Maybe I've been a little bit of a grouch. I used to think no one cared about us old folks.}}

''10 Hearts''
{{Squote|You know, I really have been a grumpy old man to everyone. But now I feel like I'm softening up like an old ripe fruit. Hehe! Take care, [son / hun].}}
{{Squote|[Player]! Let me turn off this darned television and we can have a little chat. So what are the young people doing these days?}}
{{Squote|You know, I shouldn't get too depressed about my legs. I should just be happy that I'm alive.}}
{{Squote|When you get as old as me it's a lot harder to adjust to new things. One day you'll know what I mean. Go on, enjoy yourself while you're still young.}}

'''Green Rain'''
''Year 1''
{{Squote|There, there, honey... Don't you worry. Even if it is poisonous, I breathed in more noxious gas in one minute back in the ol' coal mines... And I'm still kickin'!}}
''Year 2+''
{{Squote|Looks like the young folks will have to do some extra weeding after this one... Heheh...}}

'''Player married to Alex'''

''Male player''
{{Squote|How can two men get married? It's unnatural... Hmmph. I guess I'm just "old fashioned"...}}
''Male player, 10 Hearts with George''
{{Squote|I'll admit, I thought it was... strange... for two men to be together. But you're such a nice young man, and I know you two are in love... I've changed my mind.}}
''Female player''
{{Squote|You're part of the family, now. I'm glad that my grandson found such a nice wife.}}
''Female player, 10 Hearts with George''
{{Squote|You're part of the family now... and I couldn't be more proud.}}

'''Doctor Visit'''

''Before leaving home for doctor visit''
{{Squote|Hmmpph... The wife's making me go to the clinic today.}}

''In the clinic's waiting room''
{{Squote|*grumble*... Good for nothing doctors... *grumble*}}

''In the clinic's examination room''
{{Squote|Well how much longer do I have, Doc?}}

'''Visiting [[Yoba]]'s altar'''
{{Squote|I've never been religious, But hey... I'm old}}
|}

{|class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"
! style="text-align: left;" | '''Events'''&nbsp;
|-
|
'''[[Egg Festival]]'''

''Odd-numbered year''
{{Squote|What's everyone so happy about? Hmmph... Eggs... why eggs?}}
''Even-numbered year''
{{Squote|Evelyn made eggs and leeks for breakfast, so I'm in a good mood.}}

'''[[Desert Festival]]'''
''Even-numbered year''
{{Squote|What is she mumbling about? I'm here for the spicy food tent!}}

'''[[Flower Dance]]'''
{{Squote|Flowers? I can hardly see them. It's too bright out here!}}

'''[[Luau|The Luau]]'''

''Odd-numbered year''
{{Squote|That music! It's too loud. Can't I have a little peace and quiet to enjoy the ocean?}}
''Even-numbered year''
{{Squote|Leek and garlic mashed potatoes? Hehe... honey, I think I've died and gone to heaven!}}

'''[[Dance of the Moonlight Jellies]]'''
{{Squote|What, why are you looking at me like that? You think I'm too old to enjoy something like this?}}

'''[[Stardew Valley Fair]]'''
{{Squote|Hmm... smoked turkey haunch? I guess this festival isn't all bad.}}

'''[[Spirit's Eve]]'''
<br />''Although George does not attend the Feast, he has dialogue scripted in underlying data files.''
{{Squote|Hmm... smoked turkey haunch? I guess this festival isn't all bad.}}

'''[[Festival of Ice]]'''
{{Squote|Hmmph... Wife dragged me out into the cold for this?}}

'''[[Night Market]]'''
{{Squote|I'm just here for the free coffee.}}

'''[[Feast of the Winter Star]]'''
{{Squote|A feast for some stupid star? Humbug!}}

==Quests==
*[[Quests#Knee Therapy|"Knee Therapy"]]: George will send you a letter on the 25th of [[Summer]] requesting a [[Hot Pepper]].  The reward is {{Price|200}} and 1 [[Friendship]] heart.
*George may randomly request an item at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]].  The reward is 3x the item's base value and 150 [[Friendship]] points.
*George is to be gifted the [[Quests#Advanced TV Remote|Advanced TV Remote]] in [[Quests#The Pirate's Wife|The Pirate's Wife]] quest.

==Trivia==
*George will send you recipes for [[Fried Eel]] and [[Spicy Eel]], which are ironically two of his wife's hated gifts.
*When moving, George will make the footstep noise as if he is walking, despite being in a wheelchair.
